capabilities: Render Markdown inside <details>/<summary> blocks in Reading view
Support headings, lists, tables, internal links, and embeds inside details blocks
Leave unsupported, malformed, or unclosed blocks untouched
Toggle the plugin on or off to restore native behavior
extras: Live Preview is not supported yet; it is planned for a future release. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README frames the plugin as a fix for Obsidian's native behavior of leaving Markdown inside raw HTML blocks unparsed, but gives no further author motivation.
problem: Obsidian does not parse Markdown inside raw HTML blocks, so content inside a <details> fold shows as literal text instead of rendered Markdown.
summary: Plugin that renders Markdown (headings, lists, tables, links, embeds) inside native HTML <details>/<summary> blocks in Reading view.
